subtitle: Lesson 28 · Troubleshooting Common Deployment Issues

steps.label: Rollback
steps.sub: fast, safe, returns to known-good — doesn't fix the cause

steps.label: Fix forward
steps.sub: resolves the cause — costs time, more risk mid-incident

steps.label: Neither wins
steps.sub: the right call depends on the situation, not a rule

code:
Lean ROLLBACK when:
  - the fix isn't fully understood or tested yet
  - a large portion of the system is down, and this is production

Lean FIX FORWARD when:
  - the root cause and fix are small and clearly identified
  - blast radius is limited (one rule, one role, one resource)
caption: Stakes and certainty decide it — not a fixed rule about which approach is "better."

steps.label: Small, understood
steps.sub: one source IP range, on one existing rule

steps.label: Fixed forward
steps.sub: lower risk than rolling back the whole deployment

steps.label: Compare that
steps.sub: to an unfamiliar change with half the system down
